title: First compatible term under a bad extension
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign-valued Boolean variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted function is nonconstant. The first term compatible with the extension that fixes the selected coordinate to the sign required by the first compatible term has the same index as the first term compatible with $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
The function restricted by $\rho$ is nonconstant
The selected term index under the extension is supplied with a nonemptiness witness for the compatible indices
